links.outcome: Accuracy on external test set of differently formatted pathology reports from a separate institution
links.effect: LLM maintained high accuracy without additional training; rules-based NLP achieved similarly high accuracy only after minimal refinement.
links.quote: In an external test set of differently formatted RP pathology reports from a separate institution, the LLM maintained high accuracy without additional training, while the rules-based NLP model achieved similarly high accuracy after minimal refinement.

screen.reason: Empirical comparison of a rules-based NLP system vs. a zero-shot LLM for generating patient-centered pathology report summaries using retrospective institutional pathology reports.
